run_animal_web_handler: run the animal_web_handler function to extract and process the AnimalWeb dataset from a given path
extract_animal_web_rar: extract the AnimalWeb dataset RAR archive using unrar within the handler function
extract_animal_web_tar: extract the AnimalWeb dataset TAR.GZ archive as a fallback when unrar is unavailable
generate_image_label_pairs: generate image and label pairs from JPG files in the dataset directory using the make_gen function
deduplicate_and_split_data: deduplicate image data and split into train and dev sets using random split fractions
